messages:
Maria G.: Quick design review — run history + tool-calling microcopy on staging feels ambiguous. Left a few Figma notes but wanted to surface the high-level things here so we can iterate fast. :wave:

Kevin L.: thanks — can you call out the top 3? I skimmed and noticed some inconsistent verbs.

Maria G.: 1) The button that expands a tool call currently says "Open" in one place and "View output" in another. Users aren't sure whether they'll get a live replay or a compact summary. Suggest: use "Expand run" for the panel affordance and "Show details" for metadata links.

Sophie R.: +1 on consistent verbs. Also accessibility: the expand control doesn't expose aria-expanded in the DOM. Screen reader users get no state. Minimal fix: ensure the toggle is a real button and aria-expanded toggles.

Kevin L.: can you paste a tiny snippet we can drop in?

Sophie R.: sure — something like:
```html
<button class="run-toggle" aria-expanded="false">Expand run</button>
```
and toggle to "true" when expanded. Also ensure focus outline is visible (no outline: none).

Maria G.: 2) The compact run summary line shows the function name + truncated args. It reads: `translateText(…)` which is fine, but for new users the parentheses imply it's code. Maybe show a pill: `Translate ▸ en → fr • 3 args` — more human.

Zach (PM): I like the pill idea. Also, can we surface the schema diff summary when a function updates? e.g., "schema changed: +2 fields" in orange. That would help QA.

Kevin L.: Implementation note: we already capture function signature diffs in the run metadata. UI just needs a 1-line banner. Are we okay with a color-coded pill? Accessibility-wise, orange needs >3:1 contrast or we use an icon + neutral background.

Sophie R.: contrast is important — use a border and icon rather than relying on color alone. Add `aria-live=\"polite\"` on the banner so assistive tech hears it when the run loads.

Maria G.: 3) Microcopy for tool failures. Right now it shows "Tool error" with a stack snippet. Suggest: "Tool failed to run — try again or view details" and put the stack behind a "Show error details" secondary control. Keeps the summary calm.

Kevin L.: Agreed. Also we should surface a retry affordance and include the invocation id for support: `Retry · invocation #abc123`.

Maria G.: small UX nit: run timestamps are currently 12-hour with seconds. For timeline density I'd rather see relative times (e.g., "2m ago") and a hover that reveals the full iso timestamp.

Zach (PM): +1 relative first, exact on hover. Also could we add a keyboard shortcut to jump between runs in the history? `j`/`k` like GitHub?

Kevin L.: We can wire `j`/`k` and announce the focused run with `aria-live` for screen readers. Need to ensure focus doesn't trap when typing in the prompt textarea.

Sophie R.: make sure any global keybinding is disabled when inputs are focused. Also document the shortcut in the help menu with visible labels.

Maria G.: Another idea: inline schema preview on hover for function defs — a small tooltip that shows required fields and types. Should be collapsible for large schemas.

Kevin L.: tooltip perf could be an issue if we render huge schemas. Proposal: show a summary (top 3 fields) and a "View full schema" link to open the inspector panel.

Maria G.: agree. Copy for the tooltip header: "Schema (preview)" then list truncated keys.

Sophie R.: tooltips must be accessible — use a focusable trigger and support keyboard open (Enter/Space).

Zach (PM): Quick wording pass suggestions from PM side:
- Expand run (primary toggle)
- Show details (secondary)
- Retry · invocation #ID (action)
- Schema changed: +N fields (informational banner)
- Show error details (secondary)

Kevin L.: I'll make a quick patch on staging with: consistent verbs, aria-expanded on toggles, keyboard navigation `j/k`, and the error details collapse. Can I get design copy for the pill and banner?

Maria G.: pushing a small copy file to the thread — main variants:
- pill: `Translate • en→fr • 3 args`
- banner info: `Schema changed: +2 fields` (title) / `Some runs used older schema` (subtitle)
- error summary: `Tool failed to run — try retrying or view details`

Kevin L.: perfect. I'll link the staging build once deployed.

deploy-bot: Deployed playground run-history tweaks to staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/playground (build #2026.3.5) :rocket:

Maria G.: testing now — first pass looks promising. A couple more tiny things: 1) focused run card needs a slightly darker border (helps keyboard users), 2) reduced motion for expand animation (prefers-reduced-motion), 3) ensure the pill truncates gracefully on narrow screens (use ellipsis).

Sophie R.: noted on reduced motion. For truncation, ensure the pill has `aria-label` with the full text so screen reader users get the full context.

Kevin L.: thanks all — I'll open a PR and tag you for review. If we get quick approvals we can ship to prod next week. :sparkles:

Zach (PM): thanks team — great iteration speed. If we land this, we'll add the run-history microcopy and keyboard tips to the release notes.

Maria G.: thanks! I'll follow up with updated Figma annotations and a short checklist for QA. :memo:
